t: Norton Expert Pro Ceramic Diamond Cutting Disc with added segment strength for cutting hard tiles, ceramic and porcelain. 10mm high continuous rim blade is the perfect choice for a high quality cut. Premium diamond grade and free cutting metal bond make the blade perfect for cutting even hard tiles. Reinforced steel centre flange helps keep the blade straight without causing damage to the tile. For use with angle grinders and for dry cutting only. Part of the Norton Expert Diamond Blade range.
